entry.title: Sunflower 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release of Sunflower, a Fibonacci sequencer for the Akai MPC and Force (MPC OS 3.10.1+, external plugins enabled). Unzip, then copy the folder "Lumina Aerospace LLC - VST - Sunflower" into "VST2 Plugins" on the MPC drive (INSTALL.txt is inside). Includes 32-bit ARM and 64-bit AArch64 builds. Status: builds clean for both processors and passes the MPC Plugin SDK host simulator; the live playhead was checked in a real-time host harness. It has NOT yet been tried on a real MPC.
